title: Trend arrows are displayed incorrectly.
symptom: Trend arrows are displayed incorrectly in AAPS on high climbs, while they are displayed correctly in XDrip and forwarded to AAPS.
cause: AAPS receives data from two sources: xDrip with correct direction and NS with direction 'Flat', causing incorrect display. This is due to multiple paths uploading to NS and possibly downloading BG data from NS.
fix: Review configuration: define a single path to upload to NS, set all other clients to read-only mode, and disable download of BG data from NS if receiving from xDrip in AAPS.
evidence_quote: you should definitely review your configuration and: * define single path to upload to NS * all other clients put to read only mode * disable download of Bg data from NS if you want to receive them from xDrip in AAPS
